description: This file defines the class MultivaluedMapContext, which extends MapContext to handle multiple values per key, providing methods to add, put, and retrieve values in a multi-valued map structure.

classes.name: MultivaluedMapContext
classes.description: A map context that manages multiple values for each key, with methods to add and retrieve these values, designed to be used within the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: MultivaluedMapContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new multivalued map context.

methods.name: putSingle
methods.description: Associates a key with a single value, overriding existing values.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value to the list associated with a key, preserving existing values.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Retrieves the first value associated with a key.
